source_of_authority: RC final decisions 2026-07-24 (Grok preference interview + RC clarifications; NT16 rulings 2026-07-24 resolving OPEN-08/09/10/11/15/16/17/18/19)

sub_decisions.PREF-01.1: Canonical seven-state lesson vocabulary for the Desk navigation model
sub_decisions.PREF-01.2: Today's assignment is the Desk's primary front door
sub_decisions.PREF-01.3: "What's next" is a secondary view, not the front door
sub_decisions.PREF-01.4: Students may open any teacher-released (released) lesson
sub_decisions.PREF-01.5: Work-ahead permitted only within released material, never unreleased
sub_decisions.PREF-01.6: Primary view shows today plus nearby/recently released lessons first
sub_decisions.PREF-01.7: The broader released roadmap lives behind a secondary/expandable view
sub_decisions.PREF-01.8: Unreleased lessons are hidden/unavailable to students
sub_decisions.PREF-01.9: Skipped lessons render grey/inert, and appear only in the broader view
sub_decisions.PREF-01.10: Optional-catalog content is absent from the normal path until explicit teacher assignment
sub_decisions.PREF-06.6: Unknown/unavailable state must never render as zero
sub_decisions.PREF-06.7: Unknown/unavailable state must never render as erased work
sub_decisions.PREF-06.8: Unknown/unavailable state must never render as fabricated credit
sub_decisions.PREF-06.9: Unknown/unavailable state must never cause erroneous relocking
sub_decisions.PREF-13.2: Teacher designates today's/next lesson; there is no fixed calendar

today.description: The teacher-designated lesson for the current class day. The Desk's primary front door (PREF-01.2). A lesson must be released to be marked today; designating a not-yet-released lesson as today implicitly releases it in the same action.

released.description: Teacher has made the lesson available. Openable and workable, including work-ahead (PREF-01.4/.5), whether or not it is today's designation.

unreleased.description: Default state for every lesson at creation, before any teacher release action. Hidden/unavailable to students (PREF-01.8) -- must not appear in either Desk view.

skipped.description: Teacher has designated this lesson as not being pursued in the normal sequence. Renders grey and inert, and only in the broader roadmap view, never the primary view (PREF-01.9).

optional-catalog.description: Content-ingestion-time classification (e.g. Lesson 4-1, record nt14-ingest-4-1-2026-07-23) that is absent from the normal student path -- both views -- until a teacher explicitly assigns it (PREF-01.10, PREF-14.1/.2). Not entered via an ordinary Desk transition; it is the resting classification a lesson's content already carries when ingested this way.

completed.description: The student has server-ledger-verified evidence that satisfies this lesson's teacher-designated completion criteria (feeds PREF-03's completion-percentage mechanic). Sticky and DECIDED terminal: this Desk tile has ZERO legal exit transitions -- once reached, no event (evidence-source outage, teacher action, or within-quarter retake) ever moves it back to released/today or any other state (dossier §15 item 2; PREF-06.9). RC's 2026-07-24 ruling (OPEN-17) settles this as DECIDED policy, not a conservative placeholder: a within-quarter retake (PREF-06.4) is an ORTHOGONAL activity/affordance attached to the completed lesson -- see the top-level retake_affordance object -- it never demotes, relocks, or erases this state, and never alters the grading engine via navigation state.

temporarily-unavailable.description: The authoritative evidence source needed to determine this lesson's completion status is unreachable. Renders as UNKNOWN, never zero (dossier §15 item 1; PREF-06.6). Fail-open navigation is permitted (dossier §15 item 3) but no credit is awarded while in this state. Never applies to a lesson already known-completed (see 'completed'.sticky).

state_derivation.description: For Desk rendering, each (lesson, student) pair resolves to exactly one of the seven states via this precedence order (first match wins). 'completed' and 'temporarily-unavailable' are per-student evidence-layer overlays; the other five are curriculum/release-layer facts set once per lesson (shared by every student in the section) -- mirrors RC_TEACHER_PREFERENCE_RECORD.md's note under PREF-01.1 that five states are directly-named navigation decisions and two are structural evidence-layer states.
state_derivation.rule: Evaluate top to bottom; the first matching condition is the rendered state. 'completed' is checked first so an evidence-source outage occurring after completion can never downgrade it. 'temporarily-unavailable' is checked next, before any curriculum-layer fact, so an outage overlays whichever curriculum state currently holds without altering that underlying curriculum classification -- recovery (see transitions T16/T17) restores rendering to that same underlying curriculum state.

legal.note: Teacher designates this lesson as today's lesson; implicitly releases it in the same action.

Teacher designates this lesson as skipped without ever releasing it. CONFIRMED by RC's 2026-07-24 ruling (OPEN-18) -- this transition was already legal and decided in v1.0; the ruling settles it as confirmed policy, not a new grant. No duplicate transition id was minted for this case.
Teacher promotes an already-released lesson to today's designation.
Server-ledger evidence satisfies teacher-designated completion criteria.
Authoritative evidence source for this lesson becomes unreachable.

RC's 2026-07-24 ruling (OPEN-18) decides that an already-released (not-yet-completed) lesson CAN be retroactively marked skipped. Promoted from transitions.provisional (v1.0) to transitions.legal -- no longer a provisional, non-normative allowance.
Teacher moves the today designation elsewhere; this lesson reverts to plain released (eligible for 'nearby/recent released' display).
Same as T5, while still marked today.
Same as T6, while still marked today.

precondition.note: Legal ONLY before this lesson reaches 'completed' for this student. A completed lesson can never reach skipped -- see illegal transition X3, the guard enforcing this precondition.

legal.note: RC's 2026-07-24 ruling (OPEN-18) decides that today -> skipped is allowed BEFORE COMPLETION. Promoted from transitions.provisional (v1.0) to transitions.legal, now carrying a machine-readable precondition guarding the completed boundary.
RC's 2026-07-24 ruling (OPEN-18) decides a skip designation IS reversible. Promoted from transitions.provisional (v1.0) to transitions.legal.
Same as T12, direct to today. Promoted from transitions.provisional (v1.0) to transitions.legal.
Teacher explicitly assigns this optional-catalog lesson; the Desk-layer analogue of qb.select(include_optional=True).
Same as T14, direct to today.
Evidence source reachable again; reconciled evidence shows lesson not yet complete.
Same as T16, if the lesson still held the today designation underneath the outage.
Evidence source reachable again; reconciled evidence shows the lesson was in fact already complete -- unknown resolves to its true value, never fabricated.

illegal.reason: Core reliability invariant: an evidence-source outage may never demote or erase known-completed work.
No demotion path out of completed exists in RC's text.

No demotion path out of completed; skipping is a curriculum-pursuit designation, not an evidence-erasure action. CONFIRMED FORBIDDEN by RC's 2026-07-24 ruling (OPEN-18): completed -> skipped remains illegal, and this entry is the guard enforcing T11's pre-completion precondition -- once a lesson reaches completed for a student, T11 (today -> skipped) can never legally apply to it, and no other skip transition can either.
No demotion path out of completed; optional-catalog is a content-classification state, not reachable from a per-student completion fact.
No evidence path exists before release -- a lesson cannot be completed before it is released.
No evidence determination is meaningful before release -- nothing is being made unreachable.
Optional-catalog is a content-ingestion-time classification (NT14), not a runtime demotion target reachable from an ordinary unreleased curriculum lesson.
Skipped lessons are inert and not openable; no evidence can attach without first becoming released/today.
Same as X8 -- no evidence determination applies to an inert, unopenable lesson.
No defined 'un-skip to hidden' path; reversing a skip goes through released/today (T12/T13), never back to unreleased.
Not meaningful: skipped applies to normal-path curriculum lessons the class walked past; optional-catalog content was never on the normal path to begin with.
Optional-catalog does not fall back to ordinary unreleased status; its only forward path is explicit assignment (T14/T15).
Not meaningful: optional-catalog content was never on the normal curriculum path for the class to skip over.
Must be explicitly assigned into released/today first (T14/T15) before any evidence/completion state can apply.
Same as X14 -- no evidence determination applies to unassigned catalog content.

Illegal ONLY via the ordinary teacher_release/teacher_designate_today triggers used for normal curriculum lessons -- optional-catalog content must never auto-schedule. The sole legal path out is T14/T15 via the explicit_teacher_assignment trigger specifically.
An availability failure must never reclassify a lesson's curriculum status.
Same as X17; optional-catalog is also a content-ingestion classification never reachable via an availability failure.

provisional_retirement.reason: RC's 2026-07-24 ruling on OPEN-18 decided that released/today -> skipped and skipped -> released/today are legal (T11 conditioned pre-completion), teacher-only. These four transitions no longer belong in a non-normative provisional bucket -- they are decided policy.
provisional_retirement.superseded_bucket_history: In v1.0, T7/T11/T12/T13 lived here as transitions.provisional entries tagged "normative": false, "open_item": "OPEN-18". This bucket is now permanently empty; see transitions.legal for the promoted entries (now carrying "provenance": "RESOLVED by RC 2026-07-24" instead) and the top-level changelog for the full history.

resolved.topic: Any legal exit from completed (e.g. for a within-quarter retake, PREF-06.4) reopening the Desk tile.
resolved.resolution: completed remains TERMINAL for the Desk tile -- zero legal exit transitions, DECIDED not open. A retake is an ORTHOGONAL activity/affordance attached to the completed lesson (see top-level retake_affordance); it never demotes completion, never relocks, never erases history, and never alters the grading engine via navigation state. Implementation details of the retake affordance itself are deferred to later work packages (D8).

resolved.topic: Whether an already-released (not-yet-completed) lesson can be retroactively marked skipped.
resolved.resolution: released -> skipped is ALLOWED (T7). today -> skipped is ALLOWED BEFORE COMPLETION (T11; precondition: lesson not yet completed for this student -- a completed lesson can never reach skipped, see X3). Both are teacher-only; students cannot initiate a skip.

resolved.topic: Whether a skip designation is reversible.
resolved.resolution: Skip IS reversible: skipped -> released (T12) and skipped -> today (T13) are both ALLOWED, teacher-only. Students cannot initiate an unskip.

roadmap_view.notes: Also visible in the broader roadmap as the current position.

primary_view.notes: Primary view shows today plus nearby/recent released lessons first (PREF-01.6); a released lesson far outside that window is not necessarily surfaced on the primary view.

roadmap_view.notes: Every released lesson is visible in the broader roadmap view (PREF-01.7), work-ahead permitted (PREF-01.4/.5).

primary_view.notes: Absent from the normal path until explicit teacher assignment (PREF-01.10).

roadmap_view.notes: Also absent from the broader roadmap view until explicit assignment -- the roadmap is still part of the normal student-facing path. Once assigned it is no longer in this state (it becomes released/today) and follows that state's visibility rules instead.

primary_view.notes: Completion is additive information (a badge) on top of a lesson's prior release visibility, not a hiding state.

roadmap_view.notes: Visible and reviewable in the roadmap.

primary_view.notes: Fail-open navigation permitted (dossier §15 item 3); completion status displays as UNKNOWN, never zero (dossier §15 item 1); no credit awarded while in this state.

roadmap_view.notes: Same fail-open/no-credit rule applies in the roadmap view.

optional_catalog_rule.registry_marker: top-level "availability": "optional-catalog" field on a registry row
optional_catalog_rule.qb_select_default_behavior: qb.select() drops optional-catalog rows by default
cites: CLAUDE.md § Lesson 4-1 (OPTIONAL CATALOG -- not scheduled, not required)

reliability_invariants.statement: Unknown is a first-class rendered value. When authoritative evidence for a lesson is unavailable, the Desk reports temporarily-unavailable / UNKNOWN -- never zero and never affirmatively 'incomplete'.
Evidence-source unavailability alone can never relock or revoke known-completed work. completed is sticky with respect to temporarily-unavailable -- see transition X1.

Fail-open navigation is permitted during uncertainty -- a lesson in temporarily-unavailable may still be opened -- but official credit is only ever awarded from verified authoritative evidence. No credit accrues while a lesson renders temporarily-unavailable.
cites: PROGRAM_DOSSIER.md §15 item 3 (Fail-open navigation never awards credit)

work_ahead_rule.notes: Work-ahead is never a path into unreleased or unassigned optional-catalog content (PREF-01.5). 'completed' and 'temporarily-unavailable' lessons remain independently openable (review / fail-open) but are not 'work-ahead' targets since a student is not getting ahead into new material there.

cross_references.RC_TEACHER_PREFERENCE_RECORD.md: Source of the PREF-NN / PREF-NN.M decision text cited throughout this file.

skip_authority.rationale: Skip and unskip are curriculum-pacing designations reserved to the teacher of record; no Desk affordance allows a student to initiate or reverse a skip. completed -> skipped remains forbidden (X3) regardless of skip authority -- a completed lesson can never be skipped.

retake_affordance.description: A within-quarter retake (PREF-06.4) is an activity/affordance attached to an already-completed lesson. It is ORTHOGONAL to Desk navigation state: it never touches the completed tile's state-machine position.

OPEN-17.ruling: completed remains TERMINAL for the lesson tile. A retake is an ORTHOGONAL activity/affordance attached to the completed lesson -- it never demotes completion, never relocks, never erases history, and never alters the grading engine via navigation state. completed keeps ZERO legal exit transitions -- this is now DECIDED, not open. The retake-affordance concept is documented as orthogonal; its implementation details are deferred to the work packages.
OPEN-17.supersedes: v1's provisional_implementation_choices.OPEN-17, which kept zero legal exits from completed as a conservative reading pending RC's decision, flagged unresolved-pending-RC and subject to change if RC decided otherwise.

OPEN-18.ruling: unreleased -> skipped remains legal (T3, CONFIRMED). released -> skipped is ALLOWED (T7, promoted to legal). today -> skipped is ALLOWED BEFORE COMPLETION (T11, promoted to legal with a machine-readable precondition; a completed lesson can never reach skipped). skipped -> released is ALLOWED (T12, promoted to legal). skipped -> today is ALLOWED (T13, promoted to legal). completed -> skipped remains FORBIDDEN (X3, CONFIRMED). Students cannot initiate skip or unskip -- every skip transition carries a teacher-only actor and student_may_initiate: false.
OPEN-18.supersedes: v1's provisional_implementation_choices.OPEN-18, which recorded T7/T11/T12/T13 in transitions.provisional (normative: false) as a non-normative implementation placeholder pending RC's answer.

resolved_items_affecting_this_policy.OPEN-17: RESOLVED: 'completed' is DECIDED terminal at the Desk-tile layer (zero legal exits); a within-quarter retake is an orthogonal affordance, not a Desk-state transition.
resolved_items_affecting_this_policy.OPEN-18: RESOLVED: 'skipped' is reachable after release (released/today -> skipped, T7/T11 promoted to legal; T11 conditioned pre-completion) and a skipped designation IS reversible (skipped -> released/today, T12/T13 promoted to legal). All skip/unskip transitions are teacher-only.
